repairPrerequisites: Before implementation, define a single exact destination-address custody contract: every actual new socket, retry, reconnection and redirect must use a freshly validated address or a fixed vetted set, never a separately resolved unchecked hostname. Validate every returned address; preserve never-allowed link-local/unspecified/multicast behavior and existing explicit private-host opt-in.

Preserve the original logical hostname for TLS SNI and certificate identity, HTTP Host and SigV4 signing; do not silently replace all URL host fields with an IP or loosen TLS verification to make pinning work. Keep existing sslmode semantics separately documented; required encryption is not server-identity verification.

Postgres: pinned3.4.7 actually exposes options.socket (connection.js:127-132 and336-337), contrary to the historical unsupported-hook wording. Any use must prove pinned connect address, driver SSL upgrade/SNI on that same connected socket, bounded connect errors, and all reconnect/host-failover behavior.

MySQL: actual stock mysql/mysqldump CLI resolves --host itself. Define a genuinely enforced vetted endpoint for both tools and every query/import/readback, preserving current CLI/TLS/auth behavior. Do not rely on a separate JS lookup or introduce a silent hostname refusal/fallback without an explicit support-contract decision.

S3: bind validated transport resolution through the actual SDK HTTP handler/agents for custom endpoints, including new sockets, retry attempts, cached-client lifetime and redirects. Preserve HTTP Host/SigV4/TLS name and actual destination-bucket identity checks. No unchecked default agent fallback.

Add actual transport-level controlled-DNS tests for all3 connectors: permitted hostname becomes private/link-local before actual socket and on retry; refused destination receives no connection/request. Also run permitted public/literal or explicitly allowed owned-loopback paths against genuine owned DB/S3 fixtures, positive TLS-name checks, IPv4/IPv6/mixed-answer refusals, and independent export/import/readback. These tests must exercise production connectors and actual socket endpoints rather than only injecting preflight lookup output.

Keep operation/approval/tenant-vault/bucket authority, strict skips/exits/counts, source binding, positive owned-fixture cleanup and published migrations unchanged. Reviewer must independently inspect source delta and real transport outputs before any network-safe/default-journey claim.
